title: New York
original_lyrics:
[verse]
If you were here beside me

[intro]
If the curve of you was curved on me
I' tell you that I loved you

[chorus]
If our hearts are never broken
Well there's no joy in the mending
There's so much this hurt can teach us both
Though there's distance and there's silence
Your words have never left me
They're the prayer that I say every day.

[chorus]
The lone neon nights
And the ache of the ocean
And the fire that was starting to spark
I miss it all, from the love to the lightning
And the lack of it snaps, me in two

[verse]
If you were here beside me

[intro]
Of the arms you said you' never leave
I' tell you that it's simple
And it was only ever us
There is nowhere else that I belong

[chorus]
The lone neon nights
And the ache of the ocean
And the fire that was starting to spark
I miss it all from the love to the lightning
And the lack of it snaps, me in two
Just give me sign
There's an end and beginning
To the quiet chaos driving me mad
The lone neon nights
And the want of the ocean
And the fire that was starting to go out
